why: Corpus miss recorded in PR #641 (go #40): the diff documents WEBHOOKRELAY_ALLOWED_TOPICS with a single example value and never says it is a comma-separated list, while the same diff parses it with strings.Split(raw, ","). An operator who writes a space- or semicolon-separated value gets one topic that matches nothing. Dimension 10 (config-key documentation) is the block that reads the diff's own parsing line against its documentation line; with dimension routing on, this case fails if a batch holding the README and the parsing code stops carrying it.
prDescription: Adds WEBHOOKRELAY_ALLOWED_TOPICS so an operator can restrict which webhook topics are forwarded.
